scope: future-only games locked under snapshots/<game_id>/<locked_utc>/ before kickoff
historical_note: No 2025/2026 game already played when this protocol was written counts as pristine holdout evidence; weeks 1-9 of 2026 were seen during development.

eligible_snapshot.covered_by_freeze: lock hash listed in PROTOCOL_FREEZE.json, or locked after the freeze

comparison: model vs each book's own no-vig probability at the frozen quote (raw model only; no market anchoring)

micro.definition: unweighted mean of per-game metric values among SCORED locks
micro.denominator: games with a non-null value for that metric

macro.definition: unweighted mean of per-week means; each week mean is the unweighted mean of that week's scored games
macro.denominator: weeks that have at least one non-null value for that metric

zero_n_cells.detail: If a metric has zero non-null values in the aggregation denominator, the aggregate is null. Never substitute 0, never drop the metric silently, never renormalize unscorable or NOLINE market cells into the scored denominator.

aggregation.unscorable_exclusion: Games whose status is not SCORED never enter micro or macro numerators or denominators. NOLINE market comparisons null out book Brier cells only; the game still counts for non-market primary metrics when SCORED.

one_lock_per_game: the latest eligible lock before kickoff is scored; earlier locks are recorded but not scored
